title: Marylebone Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, walk-in centres, hazards, and essential supplies in Marylebone.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. 24-Hour Emergency Hospitals (A&E):
- University College Hospital (UCH): 235 Euston Road, NW1 2BU. From Marylebone station: ~25 min walk east along Marylebone Road and Euston Road (approx 1.2 miles), or bus 18 or 205 east directly to Euston Square / UCH.
- St Mary's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Praed Street, Paddington, W2 1NY. From Marylebone station: ~15 min walk west along Marylebone Road and south down Harewood Avenue or Chapel Street to Praed Street (approx 0.7 miles), or bus 205 west.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- St Charles Urgent Treatment Centre: Exmoor Street, W10 6DZ. From Baker Street: bus 18 westbound towards Sudbury, alight at St Charles Square.
- UCH Urgent Treatment Centre: Ground Floor, 235 Euston Road, NW1 2BU (co-located with A&E).

3. Local Hazards & Infrastructure:
- Major thoroughfares (Marylebone Road, A40 flyover) carry extremely heavy traffic, which may congest rapidly or block emergency vehicle routing during blackouts.
- Surface water ponding can occur along lower-lying segments near Baker Street junction and Regent's Canal approaches during intense rainfall.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
- Pharmacies and large supermarkets along Marylebone High Street, Baker Street, and Edgware Road provide clean drinking water, basic medical provisions, and non-perishable food during power disruptions.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible (verify locally).
